alisha: quick flag 1: ran a focused bring-up for citrine-lite-11b (int6-v2) vs int8 baseline. sharing a short scorecard + a proposed minimal roll plan. need product/GTN take on tolerances.

 tom: can you paste the top-line metrics? particularly p90 and any EM/QA deltas.

 alisha: paste below (mixed slices: conversational, summarization, code assist). small n (~4k prompts each).
```
Model                | p50  | p90  | gen toks/s | cost/token | EM (%) | QA F1 | BLEU delta
citrine-lite-11b-int8 | 95ms | 380ms |  88       | $0.0028    | 42.1   | 0.81  | baseline
citrine-lite-11b-int6v2| 70ms | 170ms | 130       | $0.0016    | 40.9   | 0.79  | -0.014
```

 qa-bot: automated smoke: code-assist slice EM -1.2pp, summarization ROUGE -0.015, hallucinations negligible. latency tail improvement ~55%.

 devin: unit econ math: int6v2 is ~43% cheaper per token. For our chat traces (avg gen 120 tokens), saving ~ $0.0144 per call. At 500k calls/day that's ~$7.2k/day.

 tom: that's decent. product concern: code-assist EM drop 1.2pp could be visible. any targeted priming/calibration attempted?

 alisha: yes 1: we ran lightweight prompt-rewrite + temperature tuning on code slice; EM improved by ~0.5pp but not fully recovered. Suggest hybrid routing + slice-sensitive prompt overrides.

 infra-bot: infra check 1: int6v2 requires new kernel flags but supported in Dedicated and Private; cold-start memory ~2GB lower which helps density.

 devin: proposal for GTN pilot:
- Canary: route 15% int6v2, 85% int8 for 72h; monitor top-level KPIs: EM, QA F1, BLEU/ROUGE, hallucination rate, latency p90, error-rate.
- Calibration batch: run 100k product prompts through both variants daily during canary to produce per-slice deltas.
- Ramp rules: if EM drop <=1.0pp and ROUGE/BLEU delta <=0.02 and hallucination +<=0.4pp and latency p90 improves >=20%, increase to 50/50 for 48h.
- Final: if unit-cost reduction >30% and metrics within thresholds, promote int6v2 as default for non-safety flows; keep int8 for code-assist & regulated outputs.

 tom: agreed but add a short rollback window (24h) post-ramp with alerting on any customer-facing regression spike. Also include per-product heatmap.

 alisha: noted. I9ll prepare a one-pager + artifact link (eval notebook + sample diffs) by EOD. putting a minimal route example here:```json
{"route":[{"model":"citrine-lite-11b-int6v2","weight":0.15},{"model":"citrine-lite-11b-int8","weight":0.85}]}
```

 devin: ops note 1: enable prefix caching and soft stop token limits for summarization slice on int6v2; reduces observed delta by ~0.006 on small tests.

 tom: perfect. @alisha please cc GTN and product on the one-pager. We'll slot the canary for next week's rolling window. :thumbsup:

 alisha: will do. thanks all.
